newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Soccer-Wimbledon's Goodman called up for Ireland.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Wimbledon's Goodman called up for Ireland.

text.p: Wimbledon striker Jon Goodman was called into the Republic of Ireland squad for the first time ahead of the friendly international against Wales in Cardiff on February 11, the Football Association of Ireland (FAI) said in a statement on Wednesday.
Goodman came on as an 85th minute substitute for goal scorer Marcus Gayle in Wimbledon's 1-0 defeat of Manchester United in the fourth round of the English FA Cup on Tuesday.
He replaces Waterford striker David Connolly who was forced to withdraw from the Irish squad because of a hamstring problem.
